runs.stage: Before origin changes: reindexing and reflection regressions; initial unbounded weighting oracle.
Origin metadata/native plumbing: one amplified block-pair gradient discrepancy with weights 1..6627.
Bounded nonuniform weights, default-resolution custom origins, persistence, all grid points and adjacent ULPs.
Extended to 20/30 degree grids and coarser nonrotameric chi, before metadata-address and spline-stride fixes.
Same rectangular native regressions with detailed mismatch diagnostics.
All nine independent spline layout/fitting checks fail before numeric changes.

Stride-aware interpolation and contiguous fitting expose three short-grid fitting failures plus previously hidden Dunbrack metadata-address errors. The metadata replacement script had rejected its own match count and changed no files.
All coupled fixes: grid registration, native metadata rows, interpolation strides and short-period recurrence.
Broad CPU/CUDA scoring, sampling, mirror packing, backbone torsions and numeric tests; Slurm 250626.

cpu_dense_interpolation_profile.limits: Single-thread native evaluation of dense 36-bin coefficients, including output allocation and Python binding overhead. Values and derivatives agree exactly. Seven alternating warm rounds; construction and compilation excluded. This is not a CUDA or whole-pose benchmark. No reduced allocation is claimed.

limits: Before/after test sets evolve explicitly as additional defects are exposed; their totals are not one unchanged suite.

The initially amplified gradient test weights reached 6627. A bounded 0.5..1.5 nonuniform weighting oracle makes tolerance independent of block-pair count; absolute/relative tolerances were not relaxed.
Reflection permutes data without resampling and updates origins. Float32 metadata remains limited by its representable coordinate precision. Sampling records its source frame separately.
Coarsened custom data is synthetic test input, not a scientifically refitted lower-resolution library.
Native metadata indexing, interpolation strides and the short-period recurrence are inherited assumptions exposed by generalized tables; they are not claimed to originate in PR 503.

All 50 pre-existing default tensor fields and three lookup DataFrames are checked exactly. The additional sampling source-origin field aliases existing storage for the default/empty databases. Custom origins may allocate two float32 values per installed library.
CPU dense interpolation benchmark is local to spline evaluation. It is not a CUDA timing, whole-pose performance measurement or memory-peak comparison.
Broader attachment parameter coverage, older noncanonical reference failures, stochastic multi-position packing and independent scientific parameter validation remain outside this gate.
